  "memo":"R08 holds because 3 accounts used the shipping address. Although this is the home address, its registration age does not satisfy the household exception. Linkage is the only adverse family; no other rule holds and no earlier outcome settles the order. Shared household use remains plausible, while coordinated identities are unconfirmed. With no completed checks, recommend needs_check under FP-2 §6.6(b), implemented as a hold with id_check. This is the only required verification and the cheapest decision-changing next check.
